examples.title: Alternating Sections
examples.code:
<>
  <Section>
    <Title>First Band</Title>
    <SubTitle>Default scheme-main background.</SubTitle>
  </Section>
  <Section bgColor="scheme-main-bis">
    <Title>Second Band</Title>
    <SubTitle>Subtly offset, and it adapts to dark mode.</SubTitle>
  </Section>
  <Section bgColor="scheme-main-ter">
    <Title>Third Band</Title>
    <SubTitle>One step further, still zero custom CSS.</SubTitle>
  </Section>
</>

accessibility:
- The section renders as a semantic `<section>` for improved structure and accessibility.
- Use headings (`<Title>`, `<SubTitle>`) and semantic content for screen reader support.

:::note
Sections help organize your document outline for screen readers and SEO.
:::
